svg.title: Cellulosome assembly and bacterial anchoring
svg.desc: Schematic renewal of original ODP slide 32. Nine enzyme-owned Type I dockerins bind nine scaffoldin-owned cohesins. Scaffoldin bears a branched CBM, the source X mark, and one Type II dockerin. That dockerin binds the anchoring protein Type II cohesin; three SLH prongs contact the bacterial cell. Source-specific counts and unmeasured illustrative protein shapes.
